summary: Iteration-4 frontend E2E testing of the major TMS UI upgrades (OrderInput, Contracts/Perjanjian Rate, Recap, Invoices, Payments, Panjar Kerja). All 9 scenario groups exercised across operation/admin/finance roles via Playwright against the public preview URL with basename /arc. 8/9 pass cleanly; 1 has a real data-testid bug (Recap Card testids dropped) plus minor React warnings.

ui_bugs.issue: Card component signature is `({ children, className })` and does NOT spread the remaining props. Any `<Card data-testid="...">` usage silently drops the testid from the DOM. Confirmed: on /recap the spec-required testids `table-open-no-cost` and `table-ready-reconcile` are absent from the DOM even though they are present in Recap.js source (lines 190 & 231). H3 headings render correctly, so the tables themselves work — only the testids are missing. Fix: change Card to `({ children, className = '', ...rest }) => <div className={...} {...rest}>...` OR move the testid onto an inner element.

Settle Panjar modal opens correctly (data-testid="settle-panjar-modal" + confirm-settle-panjar present) but the spec-required `actual_amount` input has no data-testid. Suggest adding `data-testid="panjar-actual-amount"` (and similarly for refund / settle-date / notes inputs) for automation.
Duplicate key warning in console: city code `PNK` is listed twice in DEFAULT_CITIES (line 13 and line 16). Produces a React warning on every /orders/new mount. Cosmetic, no functional impact.

React warning: 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' fired on /payments and /recap navigation. Likely a setState inside render path (e.g., AuthProvider or FeatureFlagsProvider doing a setState during render). Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

test_results_detail.order_input: PASS — all 25 expected data-testids present (awb, reff, pickup-date, company-select, customer-select, consignee, contract-select, origin/destination + datalist#city-list, service LCL/FCL/LTL/FTL/AIR, via D/L/U, status-pengiriman blank/Reguler/Project, item-description, goods-content, koli-count, koli-qty, tariff, qty, tax PPN 0/1/11/12 incl. PPN 1%, armada, driver, nopol, insurance-yes/no, insurance-policy & insurance-amount conditional, submit-order-btn). Full submission created AWB TST-38255 → toast 'AWB ... berhasil dibuat' → navigated to /orders.
test_results_detail.customer_consignee_layout: PASS — both fields share parent div with class 'mt-4 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4' (2 children).
test_results_detail.contracts_perjanjian_rate: PASS — 'Perjanjian Rate' label and via column header present; add-contract-btn opens modal with save-contract-btn. (Did not exercise full save → row verification due to existing seed data — code path & testids confirmed.)
test_results_detail.recap_three_tables: PARTIAL — H3 headings 'Open — Belum Ada Cost', 'Ready to Reconcile', 'Sudah Reconciled' all render. plot-cost-btn-{awb} and reconcile-selected-btn present. BUT spec-required Card-level testids table-open-no-cost and table-ready-reconcile are dropped due to the Card component bug above.
test_results_detail.invoices: PASS — bulk-create-invoice-btn (Bulk Create Invoice (2)) and bulk-print-pdf-btn (Print to PDF (5)) both present; 5 invoices already listed in Daftar Invoice.
test_results_detail.payments: PASS — bulk-mark-paid-btn present & correctly disabled (no selection); 2 single mark-paid-{id} buttons present; clicking single opens mark-paid-modal with payment-invoice-number and payment-paid-date inputs.
test_results_detail.panjar_kerja: PASS — panjar-page renders; add-panjar-btn opens add-panjar-modal with panjar-recipient/purpose/amount/date + save-panjar-btn; created new row PNJ-202606-0004 with toast 'Panjar dibuat'; settle-panjar-{number} opens settle-panjar-modal with confirm-settle-panjar button. (Settle confirm not exercised since actual_amount input lacks a testid — see ui_bug above.)

action_items: FIX (HIGH): `Card` component in /app/frontend/src/components/ui.js must spread extra props so data-testid is preserved. Change `export function Card({ children, className = '' })` → `export function Card({ children, className = '', ...rest })` and add `{...rest}` to the returned div. This restores Recap testids table-open-no-cost and table-ready-reconcile and prevents the same bug from masking testids on every other Card in the app.

FIX (MEDIUM): Add data-testid attributes to the Settle Panjar modal form inputs — at minimum `panjar-actual-amount` (Realisasi Pengeluaran), `panjar-refund-amount`, `panjar-settle-date`, `panjar-settle-notes` — so the settle flow can be fully automated.
FIX (LOW): Remove the duplicate 'PNK' entry from DEFAULT_CITIES in /app/frontend/src/pages/OrderInput.js (appears on line 13 AND line 16).

INVESTIGATE (LOW): React 'Cannot update a component while rendering a different component' warning fires on /payments and /recap mounts — likely from AuthProvider / FeatureFlagsProvider doing setState during render. Move side-effects into useEffect.
critical_code_review_comments: Card component (/app/frontend/src/components/ui.js L16) silently swallows all extra props — this is the kind of bug that hides testids and aria attributes across the entire app. Spread `...rest` onto the div.

OrderInput.js uses `setForm` from inside a useEffect that depends on customer_id and clears contract_id every time — this re-fires onContractChange logic indirectly and is the likely source of the React state-during-render warning when combined with the api.get('/contracts'…) chain.
OrderInput.js DEFAULT_CITIES has a duplicate 'PNK' producing a console warning on every render — small but visible quality issue.

success_rate.frontend: 8/9 scenarios fully PASS, 1 PARTIAL (Recap Card-testids dropped due to ui.js Card bug). ~89% green.

test_credentials: admin/admin123, operation/operation123, finance/finance123 — all verified working
seed_data_creation: Created one AWB (TST-38255) via the Input Order form using existing seeded customer. Created one Panjar Kerja row PNJ-202606-0004 (TEST_Recipient_*) via Panjar add form. Both via UI, intended as functional verification — main agent may wish to keep or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Single root-cause UI bug to fix in this iteration: Card component prop-spread. Once that one line is fixed in /app/frontend/src/components/ui.js, the Recap testids should re-appear automatically. Then verify by querying [data-testid="table-open-no-cost"] and [data-testid="table-ready-reconcile"]. All other flows (OrderInput full submit, Contracts add, Invoices bulk-create + bulk-print, Payments bulk-mark-paid + single mark-paid modal, Panjar add + settle modal) are wired up correctly and pass. The Settle Panjar modal's actual_amount input still lacks a testid — recommend adding before next automation run.
rca_of_the_issue: Card({children, className}) in components/ui.js does not destructure remaining props. React drops any unrecognized prop passed to a functional component if the component does not pass it through. data-testid='table-open-no-cost' and data-testid='table-ready-reconcile' on Recap.js Card usages are therefore never rendered onto the underlying <div>. Reproduction: open /arc/recap as operation, run document.querySelector('[data-testid="table-open-no-cost"]') in console → returns null even though the H3 'Open — Belum Ada Cost (Perlu Plotting Biaya)' is on screen. Mitigation: spread ...rest in the Card component and re-test.
